$comment: Time-boxed npm-audit exceptions. Each entry is a GHSA the CI audit gate will tolerate at high/critical severity UNTIL `expires`. After that date the allowlist is ignored and the gate fails again, forcing resolution. Consumed by scripts/ci/audit-allowlist.mjs (Security workflow). This is NOT a place to silence real exposure: every entry must be triaged non-reachable in this app and tracked to a fix.
reason: Astro 6->7 major upgrade (astro 7.1.x + @astrojs/cloudflare 14 + @clerk/astro 4 + wrangler 4.114) is the only fix for these advisories. Every advisory below was triaged non-reachable in this app on 2026-07-23 (evidence in #1623). RE-DATED 2026-07-30 (Captain decision) 07-30 -> 08-04, and the ORIGINAL RATIONALE IS NOW WRONG in a way worth correcting rather than carrying forward: it said the fix was blocked by the .npmrc min-release-age=7 cooldown until ~2026-07-30, assuming we needed astro 7.1.6 (published 2026-07-29, one day old). The advisory range is astro <=7.0.9, so astro 7.1.0 (published 2026-07-16) already clears BOTH the vulnerable range and the 7-day cooldown. Availability is no longer the blocker — the remaining blocker is the paired migration work itself across marketing + admin + portal, which is #1623 and wants its own attention rather than being done under deploy pressure. This window exists to ship the Phase-1 reply-channel fixes (overlay#200 / ss#2078: a failed create_draft used to email the client, and the reply gate silently blocked answers naming real matters); it is NOT a renewal habit. Independently re-verified on 2026-07-30 that the View Transitions triage still holds: zero ViewTransitions/ClientRouter/transition:* usages anywhere in src/. Dropped the GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (brace-expansion) entry in the same pass: scripts/audit-allowlist.mjs reported it matches no current advisory, so the lockfile already carries the fix and the entry was dead weight.

allow.GHSA-4g3v-8h47-v7g6: Astro reflected XSS via View Transition animation props. Not reachable: we use no View Transitions (no <ViewTransitions>/transition:* directives anywhere). Fixed in astro 7.x.
allow.GHSA-7pw4-f3q4-r2p2: Astro XSS via transition:* directive values on hydrated islands. Not reachable: zero client-hydrated islands, no UI-framework integration. Fixed in astro 7.x.
allow.GHSA-f48w-9m4c-m7f5: Astro XSS via unescaped spread attribute names. Not reachable: every {...spread} in .astro uses static literal keys, never attacker-controlled. Fixed in astro 7.x.
allow.GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj: sharp inherited libvips CVEs. Not reachable: sharp is never imported/invoked; imageService is 'passthrough' and we use no astro:assets. Pure transitive dep. Cleared by the astro 7 / adapter 14 dep tree.
allow.GHSA-2p49-hgcm-8545: svgo removeScripts leaves scripts intact. Not reachable: svgo is an Astro-internal dep, never invoked (no astro:assets SVG path). Cleared by astro 7.
allow.GHSA-4c8g-83qw-93j6: fast-uri host confusion via failed IDN canonicalization. Not reachable: fast-uri is dev/typecheck tooling only (@astrojs/check -> language-server -> ajv), not in the Worker bundle. Cleared by @astrojs/check bump.
allow.GHSA-v2hh-gcrm-f6hx: fast-uri host confusion via literal backslash authority delimiter. Not reachable: same dev-only tooling path as GHSA-4c8g-83qw-93j6. Cleared by @astrojs/check bump.
